All Additional Central P.F. Commissioners (Zones),
All Regional P.F. Commissioners of Regional Offices,
All Officers-in-charge of District Offices.

Sub: Departmental Representative (DR) in quasi-judicial proceedings-Regarding.
Sir/Madam,

It is brought to the notice of the Head Office that in certain quasi-judicial
proceedings under section 7A of the EPF & MP Act, 1952, Accounts Officers have
been allowed to appear as Departmental Representatives. The functional roles of
Accounts Officer (AO) and Enforcement Officer (EO) are altogether different and it is
clarified that under no circumstances an AO shall be allowed to appear as
departmental representative in any 7A inquiry.

Pe. Hence, all ZOs/ROs are advised to ensure that only an Enforcement Officer
appears as DR in such proceedings. Any violation will be viewed seriously.

(This issues with the approval of the CPFC)

Yours faithfully,

Ar

(Jag Mohan)
